description: RecoveryReplayFull is a finite TLA+ abstraction of recovery replay state, not production Rust or storage implementation semantics.
impact: TLC evidence applies only to modeled variables/actions/invariants.
Primary PASS is bounded safety only; no arbitrary cardinality or unbounded event proof is claimed.
Historical exploding cfg is preserved for bug-finding/stress only; it was not run and is not approval evidence.

description: Digest values are abstract finite values in Digest={0,1,2,3}; model proves check-order state, not cryptographic hash correctness.
impact: DigestVerificationOrder evidence covers workflow-before-IR sequencing only.

description: ActionAbiMismatch and PolicyDigestMismatch are abstract typed error reachability witnesses using finite expected/found mismatch, not evidence of runtime GAP-3 lookup implementation.
impact: Bridge/implementation proof must still cover concrete runtime lookup if required.

description: CorruptSnapshot is modeled as an abstract corrupt input transition, not payload decoding or serialization proof.
impact: TLC only proves the typed error can be causally recorded from the modeled corrupt input.

description: FrameDimensionOverflow uses Len(journal) >= MAX_EVENTS as the model's small dimension-overflow trigger.
impact: This witnesses the error variant under finite model dimensions; it is not a proof of concrete frame-size arithmetic.

description: Witness cfgs intentionally check negated reachability invariants; expected invariant violations are classified as witness evidence, not safety proof completion.
impact: Non-zero TLC exit is acceptable only when the specific planned negated invariant violation appears in the log.
